description: Reference terminology for PregnancyParser. Regex patterns detect pregnancy/lactation in age_group + source_quote. Parsers do NOT load this file (no logic change).
logic_notes: If extraction field 'pregnancy' is bool, use it directly.
Else search age_group + source_quote (lowercased) for pregnancy_re.
If 'не рекоменд' and 'беремен' both present → pregnancy=False (contraindicated).
